notes: Run from the Locus plugin root. Scenarios test routing only and must not mutate local or remote state.

scenarios.title: Explain Locus without forcing a child skill
scenarios.purpose: Keep capability questions read-only until a concrete need exists.
scenarios.userInput: What does Locus do, and which skill should I use? I have no concrete repository action yet. Explain only; do not inspect or edit anything.
successChecklist: It gives a concise capability map without invoking a child skill.
It asks for or names the smallest concrete need required for routing.

scenarios.title: Find ownership before tracking work
scenarios.purpose: Make the find-to-track handoff explicit when repository ownership is unclear.
scenarios.userInput: I need to fix a connector bug, but I do not know which repository owns it. Route the work without editing files or remote state.
successChecklist: It selects locus:find first and does not start lifecycle mutations.
It names ownership resolution as the handoff for re-evaluating and selecting locus:track.

scenarios.title: Find ownership before initializing docs
scenarios.purpose: Prevent init from deciding long-lived document ownership.
scenarios.userInput: Update the canonical README and AGENTS.md, but their owning repository or package is unclear. Route the work without editing files.
successChecklist: It routes to locus:init only after a canonical owner is verified.

scenarios.title: Distill completed evidence directly
scenarios.purpose: Avoid creating lifecycle work for an already-completed knowledge-promotion request.
scenarios.userInput: Implementation is already complete and synchronized. Promote its verified durable lessons into the known canonical owner. Route only; do not edit files.
successChecklist: It does not invoke locus:track merely because implementation happened earlier.

scenarios.title: Track directly when ownership is known
scenarios.purpose: Keep find and distill conditional rather than ceremonial.
scenarios.userInput: The current repository clearly owns a dependency-update Task that must be classified and resumed. Route only; do not edit files or remote state.
successChecklist: It selects locus:track directly without locus:find.
It does not preselect locus:distill before completion reveals durable knowledge.
